issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'Phước cho dân ta Ê-díp-tô' (blessed be Egypt my people), but the Vietnamese renders 'dân ta A-si-ri' (my people Assyria), swapping Egypt for Assyria in the first clause. The Hebrew order is: Egypt (my people), Assyria (work of my hands), Israel (my inheritance). The Vietnamese incorrectly repeats Assyria for the first item.
